identity_rule: lemmas: id tla:<TLA lemma id>, the TLA's persistent lemma id (https://thesaurus-linguae-aegyptiae.de/lemma/<id>). occurrences: id tla18:<row>:<token>, row the 0-based line of train.jsonl (the Hugging Face row index at the pinned commit), token the 1-based element of the sentence; the dataset gives no text or object id. A rebuild that drops an id is refused unless --allow-drop names it (or is given bare, for every id); one that gives an occurrence id another lemma, form or sentence is refused unless --allow-remap names it (or is given bare) (ingest_guard.refuse_remapped on (tla_lemma_id, form, sentence_transliteration)).

name_set.rule: a token is a proper name when the dataset tags it UPOS PROPN; no other field widens the set

non_propn_tokens_with_name_gloss.what: tokens under another UPOS that TLA glosses as a name: the divine and royal epithets (Ḥr.w 'Horus name', nṯr-ꜥꜣ, ḫnt.ꞽ-ꞽmn.tꞽw, nswt-bꞽ.tꞽ), left out

alignment_rule: a sentence is aligned when hieroglyphs, transliteration, lemmatization, UPOS and glossing split on spaces into the same number of elements; its tokens then take their own hieroglyphs, form and glossing. An unaligned sentence's tokens carry aligned: false, null token fields and sentence_hieroglyphs / sentence_glossing; their lemma counts them in unaligned_tokens and leaves them out of spellings, forms and glossing.
join_rule: every join is on the TLA lemma id alone. wikidata: the TLA-lemmata-Wikidata-2024.csv row whose tlaID is the lemma id (wikidata_class: its additionalLexicalCategory, else its referentType, else null). in_2018_extract / extract_*: the aed-tei lemma (TLA January 2018 extract) with that lemma_id. pnm_name_ids: the PNM v6 personal_names_id whose own tla field lists the lemma id; no name form is compared.
field_rule: lemma is the lemma transliteration of the lemmatization token; form is the sentence's transliteration element (the inflected form, the editor's ( ) kept); hieroglyphs as TLA writes them, JSesh codes in <g>...</g> for signs outside Unicode 15 kept; date_not_before / date_not_after the sentence's dateNotBefore / dateNotAfter as integers (negative = BCE), a lemma's the earliest and latest of its tokens; translation_de the sentence's German translation as given. tla_lemma_undefined: true (present only then) on a lemma TLA leaves unresolved: a token glossed (undefined), or pos undefined in the 2018 extract.
override_rule: overrides.json fixes fields by id, each change kept in the row's corrections with its basis. An occurrence whose corrected upos is not PROPN leaves the name set: it is not written, and overrides.left_name_set lists it with its corrections.

export.rows: each row as the private build wrote it, without source_id
export.manifest: private catalogue ids, local paths (a path is given as its file name) and build-trail keys removed; outputs rehashed
not_shipped: overrides.json (its one fix is in the MANIFEST's overrides.left_name_set)
